DiagnosticReport.conclusion:
1. 1.6 cm nodular opacity in the left upper lung zone. Recommend CT chest for further characterization.
2. Hyperinflation, which can be seen with COPD.
3. No acute cardiopulmonary process.

items.label: Lungs
items.text: The lungs are hyperinflated with flattening of the hemidiaphragms. There is a 1.6 cm rounded nodular opacity projecting over the left upper lung zone, best seen on the frontal view. No consolidation, pleural effusion, or pneumothorax.

items.label: Heart and mediastinum
items.text: Heart size is within normal limits. Calcification of the aortic knob. Mediastinal contours are otherwise normal.

items.label: Bones
items.text: Degenerative changes of the thoracic spine. No acute osseous abnormality.

answer_key.expected_followup: Answers the preop question, but surgery clearance should wait for the nodule workup.
CT chest promptly (within about 1-2 weeks) in a current heavy smoker, then pulmonology. Tell the orthopedic surgeon before the 11/18 knee surgery.
